nice_guideline_used: CG181 / PH46 / NG28 (NICE cardiovascular risk, obesity and diabetes prevention guidance)

medications.dose: Start 2.5 mg PO once daily; increase to 5 mg after 2 weeks if tolerated, then to 10 mg once daily (max tolerated)
medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually and after each dose change
medications.purpose: Control stage‑2 hypertension; reduce cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line antihypertensive for hypertension in metabolic syndrome

medications.dose: Start 5 mg PO once daily; increase to 10 mg once daily if BP remains >140/90 mmHg after ACE‑I maximised
medications.purpose: Add‑on antihypertensive if target BP not achieved with ACE‑I alone
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 allows CCB as alternative/add‑on when BP uncontrolled on ACE‑I

medications.duration: Lifelong — review lipid profile at 3 months and then annually
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL‑C and overall cardiovascular risk in metabolic syndrome
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181 recommends high‑intensity statin for adults with QRISK ≥10 % or metabolic syndrome risk factors

medications.dose: Start 500 mg PO once daily with evening meal; increase to 500 mg BID after 1 week, then to 850 mg BID as tolerated (max 2 g/day)
medications.duration: Lifelong — review glycaemic parameters every 3‑6 months
medications.purpose: Prevent progression from prediabetes to type 2 diabetes; improve insulin sensitivity
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 advises metformin for high‑risk pre‑diabetes (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² with other risk factors)

medications.dose: 120 mg PO three times daily with each main meal containing fat
medications.duration: Review at 3 months; continue if ≥5 % weight loss achieved, otherwise discontinue
medications.purpose: Pharmacologic weight loss to achieve ≥5‑10 % body‑weight reduction
medications.nice_justification: NICE PH48 recommends orlistat for BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² (or ≥ 28 kg/m² with comorbidities) when lifestyle measures alone insufficient

treatment_summary: The plan targets the individual components of metabolic syndrome: ramipril (titrated to 10 mg) for hypertension, amlodipine as add‑on if needed, atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for dyslipidaemia, metformin MR for prediabetes prevention, and orlistat for weight loss. All choices follow NICE CG181/PH46/NG28 recommendations. Baseline labs (eGFR, potassium, LFTs, lipids) and investigations for anaemia and OSA are required before initiation. Monitoring includes BP, renal function, electrolytes, lipid profile, HbA1c, and weight, with reviews at 2 weeks (BP/renal), 3 months (lipids, weight), and annually thereafter.
